en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a wide river with a road bridge crossing it. In the foreground is a riverside promenade with a rocky embankment, trees, and several people walking. A bus is driving across the main bridge, and there is a low footbridge or dam structure parallel to it. On the far bank are trees, small industrial buildings, and houses. Text is printed in the lower left and right corners of the image.
